title: Authorize delegated scopes without privilege amplification
instruction: Harden DelegatedScopeChecker without changing its constructor or authorize API. policy must be a mapping from non-empty subject strings to exact records containing allow and delegate_to lists of distinct non-empty strings; copy it defensively and reject malformed values. A delegation chain starts at subject and visits delegates in order: principals may not repeat, every hop must be explicitly listed by its predecessor, and every principal in the chain must possess a matching allow scope so delegation never amplifies privilege. Scopes have action:resource form. Action is an exact token or *, while slash-separated resource patterns support * for one segment and ** only as the final whole segment for any suffix. Malformed scopes, subjects, actions, resources, or delegate sequences raise TypeError or ValueError before authorization. Matching is order-independent and inputs are never mutated. Add tests and no dependencies.

author_metadata.notes: Wave-3 authorization lineage with delegation edges, intersection semantics, strict validation, and wildcard matching.
